info.title: getPaymentGatewayUpStatus API
info.description: PayU Get Payment Gateway Up Status API - Check real-time availability of payment options (Net Banking, Wallets, UPI) before displaying them to customers.

post.summary: get Net Banking Up Status API UPI INTENT
post.description: Check the availability status of UPI Intent (app-based UPI payments). Returns up_status indicating if UPI Intent payment gateway is operational.

key.description: Your merchant key provided by PayU. This identifies your merchant account.

command.description: The API command identifier. Must be set to "getNetbankingStatus" for this endpoint.

var1.description: Payment option code for UPI Intent. Use "INTENT" for app-based UPI payments.

hash.description: SHA-512 hash for request authentication. Formula: sha512(key|command|var1|salt). Must be computed server-side and passed as lowercase hexadecimal.
